# Fast mode

<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

Fast mode provides synchronous transcription for individual audio files. The response returns immediately after the transcription completes.

## Capabilities

-   Processes one audio file at a time
-   Returns results after transcription completes
-   Optimized for short recordings
-   Supports language detection, model selection, custom vocabulary, and Text Polishing (`en-US` only, without language detection)

Fast mode accepts mono or stereo audio. With `channel_separation=false`, stereo audio is mixed down to mono and a single transcript is returned. With `channel_separation=true`, each channel is recognized independently and each segment includes a `channel` tag.

## Audio requirements

-   Formats: WAV, MP3, M4A, MP4, and WebM
-   Channels: Mono or stereo
-   Sample rate: At least 8 kHz; 16 kHz or greater is recommended
-   Maximum duration: 2 hours
-   Maximum file size for URL input: 300 MB
-   Maximum request body size when sending audio as a data URL: 2 MB

## Transcription options

These options control recognition. For full descriptions, see [Speech configuration](/docs/ai-services/scribe/speech-configuration/).

| Parameter            | Type    | Default   | Description                                                                                                                                       |
| -------------------- | ------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `language`           | string  | `en-US`   | Language code, such as `en-US`. See [Speech configuration](/docs/ai-services/scribe/speech-configuration/) for supported languages.               |
| `segmentation_mode`  | string  | `"auto"`  | Voice Activity Detection (VAD) mode. Set `"none"` to disable.                                                                                     |
| `word_time_offsets`  | boolean | `false`   | Include word-level timestamps.                                                                                                                    |
| `channel_separation` | boolean | `false`   | Transcribe stereo channels separately.                                                                                                            |
| `diarization`        | boolean | `false`   | Identify speakers and add a speaker tag to each transcript segment.                                                                               |
| `model`              | string  | Automatic | Select a compatible recognition model. For multilingual recognition, use `zoom-scribe-multilingual` or `whisper`, the same IDs used in Live mode. |
| `language_detection` | object  | —         | Detect the input language once or continuously. Omit `model` when `mode` is `once`.                                                               |
| `profanity_filter`   | boolean | `false`   | Filter profanity when supported by the selected model.                                                                                            |
| `text_polishing`     | object  | —         | Whether to return polished text. `enabled` boolean defaults to `false`. See [Text Polishing](/docs/ai-services/scribe/text-polishing/).           |
| `vocabulary`         | object  | —         | Apply an inline phrase list to this request.                                                                                                      |
| `vocabulary_id`      | string  | —         | Apply a persistent Vocabulary Asset.                                                                                                              |

For model and language options, see [Speech configuration](/docs/ai-services/scribe/speech-configuration/). For vocabulary options, see [Custom vocabulary](/docs/ai-services/scribe/custom-vocabulary/).

## Audio transcription

Use this endpoint to send an audio file for synchronous transcription:

**`POST /aiservices/scribe/transcribe`**

### Example request (cURL)

This cURL example sends an audio file to the Scribe API and returns a transcription:

```shell
curl -X POST https://api.zoom.us/v2/aiservices/scribe/transcribe \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "file": "https://example.com/path/clip.mp3",
    "config": {
      "language": "en-US",
      "model": "zoom-scribe-en",
      "word_time_offsets": true,
      "channel_separation": false,
      "diarization": true
    },
    "outputs": {
      "text_polishing": {
        "enabled": true
      }
    }
  }'
```

#### Response (200)

```json
{
    "request_id": "3f2b8c1e-7a4d-4e9b-b6f0-1c5d8a2e9b47",
    "duration_sec": 27.4,
    "result": {
        "text_display": "Um, welcome everyone. Let's get started.",
        "segments": [
            {
                "start": 0.0,
                "end": 5.2,
                "channel": 0,
                "speaker": "Speaker 1",
                "text": "Um, welcome everyone. Let's get started.",
                "words": [
                    { "word": "Welcome", "start": 0.0, "end": 0.4 },
                    { "word": "everyone", "start": 0.41, "end": 0.9 }
                ]
            }
        ]
    },
    "outputs": {
        "text_polishing": {
            "text": "[Speaker 1] Welcome everyone. Let's get started."
        }
    },
    "model": "zoom-scribe-en"
}
```

Text Polishing is optional. When enabled, it does not replace the transcript under `result`. See [Text Polishing](/docs/ai-services/scribe/text-polishing/).
